_comment: Conference standings link out to NJ.com/highschoolsports; they are not scraped. A sport carries a 'slug' when NJ.com scopes it by conference — the standings URL is built from baseUrl + slug + defaultSeason + conference, and the homepage scoreboard links are built from the same slug. A sport carries a 'url' instead when the source is somewhere else entirely; that is only cross country here, which is scored by meet and lives on MileSplit. Ice hockey carries neither: NJ.com publishes ice hockey, but no grouping of it contains Olympic Conference schools, so it renders as plain text rather than a dead link. Two conference keys are NOT the conference's own and must not be 'corrected' to Olympic: football runs under the West Jersey Football League (WJFL) and swimming under the South Jersey Swimming League (SJSL). Every slug and conference key below was verified against a live NJ.com page; re-check with scripts/check-standings.js and update defaultSeason each year.
